description:
Six selector components share a common pattern (list of items, arrow
navigation, optional fuzzy filter, enter-to-select). Convert all six
to VDom; consider extracting a shared `Components.Selector` higher-
order function that takes an item-renderer and a key-handler so the
six concrete selectors collapse into thin specializations.

Components covered:
  * Components.ModelSelector
  * Components.SessionSelector
  * Components.SettingsSelector
  * Components.SettingsList
  * Components.TreeSelector
  * Components.SelectList

Acceptance: existing selector tests stay green; the
`render_dialog_overlay/3` branches for these six are deleted as part
of d06.6 (Screen root) cleanup.
title: Convert selectors: Model, Session, Settings, SettingsList, Tree, SelectList
